Fixed costs (bed cost, equipment cost, manpower cost, allocated indirect costs)
Profitability of CBHI schemes for the hospital
cohort: Patients undergoing abdominal hysterectomy, vaginal hysterectomy, and caesarean section covered by one of three insurance schemes
finding: The hospital experienced an operating loss for abdominal hysterectomy, vaginal hysterectomy, and caesarean section under CBHI schemes, ranging between 7% and 36%, indicating that the reimbursement rates from these schemes were insufficient to cover the costs incurred by the hospital.
mod_finding: The highest loss was observed in the Arogya Karnataka Scheme for caesarean section surgery for patients below the poverty line (BPL).
